# Australia Help Topics

Australia Help Topics (65 pages): Australia Help Topics

## Chapters
- [Australia Help Topics](section_4198253102.md): Overview The following Help topics contain information about NetSuite features that are specific to companies doing business in Australia.
  - [Australia Account Setup](section_1540887347.md): Setting up an account for an organization doing business in Australia usually requires enabling several features and installing some additional SuiteApps.
  - [Setting Up Australia-specific Preferences](section_1540889422.md): In NetSuite, you can set up your company and personal user preferences that are specific to doing business in Australia.
  - [Australia Tax Topics](chapter_N1832106.md): NetSuite provides the capability to calculate Goods and Services Tax in Australia.
  - [Australia Payment Formats](section_N1595666.md): The Electronic Bank Payments SuiteApp lets businesses in Australia to pay vendor bills and employee expenses by generating payment files formatted in the ABA specifications of the Australian Bankers Association.
  - [Shipping Integration with Australia Post](section_4274389015.md): Important: This is a NetSuite integration with third-party applications.
